content.json:
# Microsoft 365 Copilot: Security, Adoption & Usage
Executive adoption and engagement signals combined with Copilot security telemetry (jailbreak, cross prompt injection, and data grounding), sourced from **Microsoft Defender XDR** (`CloudAppEvents`) and **Office 365** (`OfficeActivity`) and enriched from `IdentityInfo`.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.description: Subscriptions you can access, including tenants delegated to you via Azure Lighthouse.
parameters.query:
resources
| summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId, selected = true

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.description: Microsoft Sentinel workspaces. Each managed tenant appears here — pick one or more to run cross-tenant.
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationsmanagement/solutions'
| where name contains 'SecurityInsights'
| project id = tolower(tostring(properties.workspaceResourceId))
| join (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
    | extend id=tolower(id)
) on id
| project id

parameters.name: BusinessUnit
parameters.label: Business Unit
parameters.description: Filter the workbook by business unit from IdentityInfo.CompanyName.
parameters.query:
IdentityInfo
| where isnotempty(CompanyName)
| extend CompanyName = replace_regex(toupper(trim(@"\s+", tostring(CompanyName))), @"\s+", " ")
| summarize by CompanyName
| order by CompanyName asc

parameters.name: Help
parameters.label: Help text
parameters.description: Show or hide the guidance panel.

content.json:
## Executive summary
Are we adopting Copilot, and is usage growing? Headline signals for the selected tenants and period.

Headline totals for the selected tenants and period: active users (distinct people who ran at least one Copilot action), total interactions, interactions per active user, active business units, and Copilot surfaces in use. Copilot events combine `CloudAppEvents` (`ActionType == "CopilotInteraction"`) and `OfficeActivity` (`OfficeWorkload == "Copilot"`).

content.query:
let Identities = materialize(
    IdentityInfo
    | project TimeGenerated, AccountObjectId, AccountUPN, AccountDisplayName, CompanyName, Department
);
let idsByObj = Identities
| where isnotempty(AccountObjectId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AccountUPN, AccountDisplayName, CompanyName, Department) by AccountObjectId;
let idsByUpn = Identities
| where isnotempty(AccountUPN)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AccountDisplayName, CompanyName, Department) by UPNkey = tolower(tostring(AccountUPN));
let cae = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "CopilotInteraction"
| extend App = tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData.AppHost)
| extend App = iff(isempty(App), "[Unknown surface]", App)
| join kind=leftouter idsByObj on AccountObjectId
| project TimeGenerated, UPN = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AccountUPN), tostring(AccountId))), DisplayName = coalesce(tostring(AccountDisplayName), tostring(AccountId)), Company = CompanyName, Department, App, Source = "CloudAppEvents";
let oa = OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Copilot" or Operation =~ "CopilotInteraction"
| extend UPNkey = tolower(tostring(UserId))
| join kind=leftouter idsByUpn on UPNkey
| project TimeGenerated, UPN = UPNkey, DisplayName = coalesce(tostring(AccountDisplayName), tostring(UserId)), Company = CompanyName, Department, App = "[Surface unavailable]", Source = "OfficeActivity";
let Copilot = union isfuzzy=true cae, oa
| extend Company = iff(isempty(Company), "Unknown", replace_regex(toupper(trim(@"\s+", tostring(Company))), @"\s+", " "))
| extend Department = iff(isempty(Department), "Unknown", replace_regex(trim(@"\s+", tostring(Department)), @"\s+", " "))
| where 'value::all' in ({BusinessUnit}) or Company in ({BusinessUnit});
let Base = materialize(Copilot);
union
(Base | summarize v = todouble(dcount(UPN)) | extend Metric = "Active users", o = 1),
(Base | summarize v = todouble(count()) | extend Metric = "Copilot interactions", o = 2),
(Base | summarize u = dcount(UPN), n = count() | extend v = iff(u == 0, 0.0, round(todouble(n) / u, 1)) | project v | extend Metric = "Interactions per user", o = 3),
(Base | summarize v = todouble(dcount(Company)) | extend Metric = "Active business units", o = 4),
(Base | summarize v = todouble(dcountif(App, App !startswith "[")) | extend Metric = "Copilot surfaces in use", o = 5)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, Value = v
content.title: Key metrics

content.json: Distinct active users per time bin. The primary signal for whether adoption is growing over the period.

## Adoption & usage
Engagement quality, onboarding momentum and where Copilot is landing across people and surfaces.

Engagement-quality KPIs: monthly active users (MAU), average daily active users (DAU), stickiness (DAU/MAU, how many monthly users show up on an average day), power users with 20+ interactions, and returning users active on 2+ days.

| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AccountUPN, AccountDisplayName, CompanyName, Department) by AccountObjectId;
let idsByUpn = Identities
| where isnotempty(AccountUPN)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AccountDisplayName, CompanyName, Department) by UPNkey = tolower(tostring(AccountUPN));
let cae = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "CopilotInteraction"
| extend App = tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData.AppHost)
| extend App = iff(isempty(App), "[Unknown surface]", App)
| join kind=leftouter idsByObj on AccountObjectId
| project TimeGenerated, UPN = tolower(coalesce(tostring(AccountUPN), tostring(AccountId))), DisplayName = coalesce(tostring(AccountDisplayName), tostring(AccountId)), Company = CompanyName, Department, App, Source = "CloudAppEvents";
let oa = OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Copilot" or Operation =~ "CopilotInteraction"
| extend UPNkey = tolower(tostring(UserId))
| join kind=leftouter idsByUpn on UPNkey
| project TimeGenerated, UPN = UPNkey, DisplayName = coalesce(tostring(AccountDisplayName), tostring(UserId)), Company = CompanyName, Department, App = "[Surface unavailable]", Source = "OfficeActivity";
let Copilot = union isfuzzy=true cae, oa
| extend Company = iff(isempty(Company), "Unknown", replace_regex(toupper(trim(@"\s+", tostring(Company))), @"\s+", " "))
| extend Department = iff(isempty(Department), "Unknown", replace_regex(trim(@"\s+", tostring(Department)), @"\s+", " "))
| where 'value::all' in ({BusinessUnit}) or Company in ({BusinessUnit});
Copilot
| summarize ["Active users"] = dcount(UPN), Interactions = count(), ["Surfaces used"] = dcountif(App, App !startswith "["), ["Last active"] = max(TimeGenerated) by Company
| extend ["Interactions / user"] = iff(["Active users"] == 0, 0.0, round(todouble(Interactions) / todouble(["Active users"]), 1))
| order by ["Active users"] desc

content.query:
let SelectedUpn = tolower('{User}');
let SelectedUser = materialize(
    IdentityInfo
    | where isnotempty(SelectedUpn)
    | extend UPN = tolower(tostring(AccountUPN))
    | where UPN == SelectedUpn
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AccountObjectId, CompanyName) by UPN
    | extend Company = replace_regex(toupper(trim(@"\s+", tostring(CompanyName))), @"\s+", " ")
    | where 'value::all' in ({BusinessUnit}) or Company in ({BusinessUnit})
    | project AccountObjectId, UPN
);
let SelectedObjectIds = SelectedUser
| where isnotempty(AccountObjectId)
| project AccountObjectId;
let cae = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "CopilotInteraction"
| where AccountObjectId in (SelectedObjectIds)
    or tolower(tostring(AccountId)) == SelectedUpn
    or tolower(tostring(RawEventData.UserId)) == SelectedUpn
| extend App = tostring(RawEventData.CopilotEventData.AppHost)
| extend App = iff(isempty(App), "[Unknown surface]", App)
| project TimeGenerated, App, Source = "CloudAppEvents";
let oa = OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Copilot" or Operation =~ "CopilotInteraction"
| where tolower(tostring(UserId)) == SelectedUpn
| project TimeGenerated, App = "[Surface unavailable]", Source = "OfficeActivity";
let Copilot = union isfuzzy=true cae, oa;
let Base = materialize(Copilot);
union
(Base | summarize v = todouble(count()) | extend Metric = "Total interactions", o = 1),
(Base | summarize v = todouble(dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))) | extend Metric = "Active days", o = 2),
(Base | summarize v = todouble(dcountif(App, App !startswith "[")) | extend Metric = "Surfaces used", o = 3),
(Base | summarize n = count(), d = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)) | extend v = iff(d == 0, 0.0, round(todouble(n) / d, 1)) | project v | extend Metric = "Interactions per active day", o = 4)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, Value = v
